verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Runner.run_streamed() for streaming agent run updates, and a dedicated Streaming guide states it lets developers subscribe to progress updates and partial responses for end-user UI display; tracing docs confirm events cover LLM generations, tool calls, and steps which align with streaming granularity. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of token-level streaming to a UI and no code example showing tool-call/step event handling in the pack.
